requirements.quote:
If validation fails, then the endpoint MUST disable ECN.  It stops
   setting the ECT codepoint in IP packets that it sends, assuming that
   either the network path or the peer does not support ECN.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can cause ECN validation to fail and verify that ECN is disabled at the endpoint.

requirements.quote:
If validation fails, then the endpoint MUST disable ECN.  It stops
   setting the ECT codepoint in IP packets that it sends, assuming that
   either the network path or the peer does not support ECN.
requirements.condition: ECN validation fails and the endpoint sends subsequent IP packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not set the ECT codepoint in IP packets that it sends.
requirements.why_checkable: The adjacent sentences define disabling ECN as stopping use of the ECT codepoint, which can be observed in subsequently sent IP packets.

requirements.quote:
Even if validation fails, an endpoint MAY revalidate ECN for the same
   path at any later time in the connection.  An endpoint could continue
   to periodically attempt validation.
requirements.condition: ECN validation has failed for a path and the connection remains active.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint may revalidate ECN for the same path at any later time in the connection, including through periodic validation attempts.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation can be checked to ensure its state machine permits later ECN revalidation on the same path after a failed validation.

requirements.why_checkable: A test can complete ECN validation successfully and verify that the implementation permits ECT marking on later packets.
